messages:
Morgan: Quick sync — can product/runtime/infra/security confirm capacity + gating for the new 'tiling' roadmap slice? Need launch criteria by Friday.
Ranjit: @Morgan short answer: perf numbers look ok on dev, but we need infra for prewarm slots + kernel pinning. p99=180ms on 2k qps with current config.
Elaine: infra here — we can allocate burst pool but need exact VM/GPU counts. Can you share expected sustained and burst qps?
Morgan: Sustained 800 qps per shard, burst to 2k for first 48h. Canary target: 5% traffic for 3 days.
Ranjit: That maps to ~12 GPUs across two zones. Also KV cache PR (https://git/repo/123) needs infra test env (staging-tiling) to validate.
Elaine: I'll set up staging-tiling env. ETA EOD tomorrow. Need testing checklist from eng.
Ranjit: Sending checklist: 
```
- smoke perf (p50/p95/p99)
- prefix cache warmup script
- kernel fallback verification
- quantized model run
```
Sam: SRE: Add me to checklist. We need runbook for fallback to fallback-model-v1 and alert thresholds: p99>250ms or error-rate>0.5%.
Aditya: Security: HSM/KMS requirements? If we use customer keys for private deploy, we need HSM onboarding. For hosted, ensure KMS-in-transit audit logs are enabled.
Morgan: Initially using hosted keys; note enterprise customers may require HSM. Let's document as optional blocker for private pilots.
Ranjit: Also runtime note: continuous batching parameters change throughput. We'll expose batching knob but default must match SLOs. Need product decision on cost vs latency tradeoff.
Morgan: Product decision: start conservative — prefer latency. Default batching small; allow ops to increase for cost after launch.
Elaine: Ops note: autoscaler policy will be conservative first 48h to avoid oscillation. We'll publish scaling windows.
ops-bot: deploybot: staging-tiling env created by Elaine — https://deploy/tiling/staging
Sam: Good, once staging perf tests pass we'll schedule a 1-hour war-room dry run with runtime + infra + product.
Morgan: I'll coordinate dry run timing. Thanks all — please add any missing acceptance criteria in-thread and tag with :white_check_mark: when ready.
